import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Read the data
data = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# 1. Sales by Product
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
product_sales = data.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
colors = sns.color_palette('viridis', len(product_sales))
ax1.bar(product_sales.index, product_sales.values, color=colors)
ax1.set_title('Total Sales by Product', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Product')
ax1.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)')
ax1.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 2. Sales by Payment Method
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
payment_sales = data.groupby('payment_method')['total'].sum()
colors_payment = sns.color_palette('Set2', len(payment_sales))
ax2.pie(payment_sales.values, labels=payment_sales.index, autopct='%1.1f%%', 
        colors=colors_payment, startangle=90)
ax2.set_title('Sales Distribution by Payment Method', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# 3. Sales by Age Group
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
age_sales = data.groupby('customer_age_group')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
colors_age = sns.color_palette('coolwarm', len(age_sales))
ax3.barh(age_sales.index, age_sales.values, color=colors_age)
ax3.set_title('Total Sales by Age Group', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xlabel('Total Sales ($)')
ax3.set_ylabel('Age Group')

# 4. Sales by Hour
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
data['hour'] = pd.to_datetime(data['time'], format='%H:%M').dt.hour
hourly_sales = data.groupby('hour')['total'].sum()
ax4.plot(hourly_sales.index, hourly_sales.values, marker='o', linewidth=2, 
         markersize=8, color='steelblue')
ax4.set_title('Sales by Hour of Day', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_xlabel('Hour')
ax4.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)')
ax4.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 5. Quantity Distribution by Product Size
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
size_qty = data.groupby('size')['quantity'].sum()
colors_size = sns.color_palette('pastel', len(size_qty))
ax5.bar(size_qty.index, size_qty.values, color=colors_size, edgecolor='black')
ax5.set_title('Quantity Sold by Size', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_xlabel('Size')
ax5.set_ylabel('Quantity')

# 6. Takeaway vs Dine-in
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
takeaway_sales = data.groupby('is_takeaway')['total'].sum()
labels = ['Dine-in', 'Takeaway']
colors_takeaway = ['#ff9999', '#66b3ff']
ax6.pie(takeaway_sales.values, labels=labels, autopct='%1.1f%%', 
        colors=colors_takeaway, startangle=90)
ax6.set_title('Sales: Takeaway vs Dine-in', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# 7. Average Price by Product
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
avg_price = data.groupby('product')['price'].mean().sort_values(ascending=False)
colors_price = sns.color_palette('rocket', len(avg_price))
ax7.bar(avg_price.index, avg_price.values, color=colors_price)
ax7.set_title('Average Price by Product', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_xlabel('Product')
ax7.set_ylabel('Average Price ($)')
ax7.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 8. Total Sales Summary
ax8 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1:])
summary_text = f"""
SALES SUMMARY
─────────────────────────────────────
Total Revenue: ${data['total'].sum():.2f}
Total Transactions: {len(data)}
Average Transaction: ${data['total'].mean():.2f}
Total Items Sold: {data['quantity'].sum()}

Top Product: {product_sales.index[0]} (${product_sales.values[0]:.2f})
Most Common Age Group: {age_sales.index[0]}
Most Popular Size: {size_qty.index[size_qty.argmax()]}
"""
ax8.text(0.1, 0.5, summary_text, fontsize=14, family='monospace',
         verticalalignment='center', bbox=dict(boxstyle='round', 
         facecolor='wheat', alpha=0.5))
ax8.axis('off')
ax8.set_title('Summary Statistics', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold', pad=20)

# Main title
fig.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Analytics Dashboard', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
